completion:
```sql
alter table public.roadmap_items enable row level security;
alter table public.item_votes enable row level security;

create policy "R1: Anyone can read roadmap_items"
on public.roadmap_items
for select
to anon, authenticated
using (true);

create policy "R2/R3: Signed-in users can see all votes"
on public.item_votes
for select
to authenticated
using (true);

create policy "R3: Signed-in users can vote on non-shipped items as themselves"
on public.item_votes
for insert
to authenticated
with check (
  user_id = auth.uid()
  and exists (
    select 1
    from public.roadmap_items r
    where r.id = item_id
      and r.status <> 'shipped'
  )
);

create policy "R3: Signed-in users can remove their own votes"
on public.item_votes
for delete
to authenticated
using (user_id = auth.uid());

-- R4: No modifications to roadmap_items via app
-- No policies for insert/update/delete on roadmap_items means denied for anon/authenticated

-- R5: Service role bypasses RLS automatically, no policies needed
```
